change: Bounded group shutdown for controller exit and lost X display, TERM 200ms then KILL while leaders remain unreaped; verify direct child and own group before signalling. Maximum reap poll 200ms. No broad process scan.

tests.kernel_process_groups: passed: resistant leader/descendant, already-exited unreaped leader, duplicate IDs, non-child and unrelated group rejected; independent child alive; own direct child reaped
tests.gtk3_recovery: passed; run started during build, so not counted as dedicated proof of new shutdown path
tests.scoped_diff_check: passed tools/theme-lab; unrelated qtquick_demo whitespace remains outside this change

limits: Native Quit and lost-display paths with a resistant preview not yet exercised
Active cancellation can still reap leader before descendant cleanup; next item
Descendants escaping their process group are not covered
No installation or personal window reopening
basis: Crash, monotonic timeout and stale-event identity completed; shutdown helper proved with real kernel groups. Native shutdown/cancellation and delivery remain. Not overall goal or visual fidelity.
